notes.title: Skeletal Avenger Full Version Launched on Steam!
Update Notes for 1.0.5 (macOS only)
notes.notes:
- Fixed rendering issues on macOS Big Sur
- Fixed launch crash on older macOS versions

The older macOS build can be found in [i]macos_old[/i] branch, in case the newer build doesn't work on older macOS versions. To change the branch for a game:

[olist]
[*] Right click the game, and select [i]Properties...[/i].
[*] Select [i]Betas[/i].
[*] Select the branch from [i]Select the beta you would like to opt into[/i] drop-down list.
[*] Close the window. The game should update to reflect the selected branch.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update in Main Branch
notes.notes:
We released a quick update with the following fixes.

- Bug with saving the most recent time attack time locally instead of keeping fastest is fixed.
- The Mr. Time intro story has key tips
- When continuing the save after a game restart the remaining ammo and ability are set correctly.

notes.title: Friday Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28509503/6f172b1c4c2f8934821a264bd6a4e8c5eee6476f.png[/img]

Working hard to iron out some of the last kinks and adding the final touches.  The latest update includes the following:

- one new dream scene for story
- went through the dialogue with some help
- fixed typos
- first mission has now better story
- enemies do not shoot when time multi < 0.02 (in time freeze)
- if less than two items, do not display counters for inventory
- Propov is now Popov
- Dunhill actor integrated
- you can now melee kill jansson and director in certain missions
- time attack time coloring improved
- filled empty rooms in hub
- no AR in level before killing mr time to make it more stable difficultywise
- chapter 5 is presented after the hub 
- the important people in the hub must live in attack level
- disabled melee in some dream scenes

notes.title: Development Update & Release Date!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28509503/7a192c2b3e9ec254df2cecc965647d6c4f98a1fa.png[/img]
Great news: Time Recoil is nearly done! All main features are in and rest of the development is mostly polishing, balancing levels, and bug fixing. Also, we have a released date!

The current steam release date for Time Recoil is 10th Aug 2017! 

We're currently running a small closed beta with a few dozen testers. We will widen our beta tests next week with more testers.
